# ATK - TikTok Live Monitor

A Chrome browser extension for real-time TikTok live stream analytics.

## Description
ATK provides real-time monitoring of TikTok live streams including chat messages (danmu), virtual gifts, viewer events, likes, and followers. It offers keyword-based alerting with webhook integration to Slack, Discord, Lark, and Telegram. Includes engagement heatmaps, sentiment analysis (PRO), word clouds, and one-click Excel export.

## Key Features
- Real-time chat/danmu tracking with keyword filtering and search
- Virtual gift tracking with coin values, sender details, and type/time charts
- Custom keyword alert rules with desktop notifications and cooldown control
- Multi-platform webhook push to Slack, Discord, Lark, and Telegram
- Engagement heatmap with composite index (chat + gifts + likes + joins) across 5-min windows
- Sentiment analysis for chat messages using on-device ML (PRO feature)
- Dynamic word cloud generation with top words from live chat
- Top user leaderboards by gift value, chat frequency, likes, and fan club level
- One-click XLSX export for all data types (gifts, chat, events, alerts, rankings, heatmap)
- Session auto-recovery after accidental tab close
- 21 language support (EN, ZH, JA, KO, DE, FR, ES, PT, RU, AR, VI, TH, TR, IT, ID, MS, FIL, MY, LO, KM, UR)

## Pricing
- Free ($0/month): Real-time monitoring, 5 alert rules, 30-record export, Top 50 word cloud, 20-min charts, Top 10 blurred leaderboard, desktop notifications.
- PRO Monthly ($9.9/month): Everything in Free plus unlimited exports, unlimited alert rules, Top 200 word cloud, full 4-hour charts, Top 50 leaderboard, sentiment analysis, clipboard copy.
- PRO Yearly ($69/year): All PRO features, save 42% vs monthly ($5.75/month equivalent).

## Target Audience
- TikTok Streamers and Creators: Understand audience engagement, track gift revenue, monitor chat
- E-Commerce Sellers and Live Shopping Hosts: Monitor product feedback, catch complaints early, track purchase intent
- Marketing and Analytics Teams: Export data for post-campaign analysis and ROI measurement
- MCN Agencies and Talent Managers: Track performance across multiple streamers
